descriere_scurta: Input signal word-serially 2
descriere: Sets the signal source for wordwise input signals. This signal value is available in connector output r8514 for further interconnection.

descriere_scurta: Input signal word-serially 3
descriere: Sets the signal source for wordwise input signals. This signal value is available in connector output r8515 for further interconnection.

descriere_scurta: AOP LOCAL/REMOTE
descriere: Setting for saving the actual configuration of the Advanced Operator Panel (AOP).

descriere_scurta: CAN SYNC object
descriere: Sets the SYNC object parameter for the following CANopen objects: - 1005 hex: COB-ID

descriere_scurta: CAN COB-ID Emergency Message
descriere: Sets the COB-ID for the emergency message (error telegram). It corresponds to the CANopen objects: - 1014 hex: COB-ID

descriere_scurta: CAN Producer Heartbeat Time
descriere: Sets the time [ms] to cyclically send heartbeat telegrams. The smallest cycle is 100 ms. For p8606 = 0, heartbeat telegrams are not sent.

descriere_scurta: CAN Node-ID
descriere: Display or setting of the CANopen Node ID. The Node ID can be set as follows: 1) Using the address switch on the Control Unit. --> p8620 can then only be read and displays the selected Node ID. --> A change only becomes effective after a POWER ON. --> CANopen Node ID and PROFIBUS address are identical. 2) Using p8620 --> Only if address 0 is set using the address switch. --> the Node ID is set as standard to 126. --> A change only becomes effective after save and POWER ON.

descriere_scurta: CAN bit rate
descriere: Setting the bit rate for the CAN bus. The appropriate bit timings are selected that are defined in p8623 in the associated sub-index.

descriere_scurta: CAN Abort Connection Option Code
descriere: Sets the drive behavior if a CAN communication error occurs.

descriere_scurta: CAN NMT state after booting
descriere: Sets the CANopen NMT state that is effective after booting.

descriere_scurta: CAN NMT states
descriere: Sets and displays the CANopen NMT state.

descriere_scurta: CAN: RPDO monitoring time
descriere: Sets the monitoring time for the process data received via the CAN bus. A value that is not a multiple integer of the CANopen sampling time is rounded-off. If no process data is received within this time, then fault F08702 is output.

descriere_scurta: CAN PDO mapping configuration
descriere: Selector switch for the PDO mapping.

descriere_scurta: CAN status word bit 14
descriere: Sets the signal source for bit 14 of the CANopen status word.

descriere_scurta: CAN status word bit 15
descriere: Sets the signal source for bit 15 of the CANopen status word.

descriere_scurta: CAN control word - auto interconnection
descriere: Sets the automatic BICO interconnection of the CANopen control word.

descriere_scurta: CAN stop option code
descriere: Setting for the CANopen control word bit 8 "Stop" (CANopen STW.8).

descriere_scurta: Identification and maintenance 4 configuration
descriere: Sets the configuration for the content of identification and maintenance 4 (I&M 4, p8809).

descriere_scurta: SINAMICS Link project selection
CBE20 firmware selection
descriere: Selects the firmware version for the CBE20.

descriere_scurta: SINAMICS Link address
COMM BOARD monitoring time
descriere: Sets the monitoring time to monitor the process data received via COMM BOARD. If, during this time, the Control Unit does not receive any process data from the COMM BOARD, then an appropriate message is output.

descriere_scurta: Activate COMM BOARD send configuration
descriere: Activate a modified send configuration for COMM BOARD. With p8842 = 1, the values in p8841 are transferred to the COMM BOARD and activated. After this, p8842 is automatically set to zero.

descriere_scurta: IF2 fault delay
descriere: Sets the delay time to initiate fault F01910 after a setpoint failure. The time until the fault is initiated can be used by the application. This means that is is possible to respond to the failure while the drive is still operational (e.g. emergency retraction).

descriere_scurta: IF2 PZD sampling time
descriere: Sets the sampling time for the cyclic interface 2 (IF2).

descriere_scurta: IE DHCP mode
descriere: Sets the DHCP mode for the Industrial Ethernet interface (X127) on the Control Unit.

descriere_scurta: IE Interface configuration
descriere: Setting to activate the interface configuration for the Industrial Ethernet interface (X127) on the Control Unit.

descriere_scurta: Activate FTP
descriere: Activation of the FTP server.

descriere_scurta: PN DHCP Mode
descriere: Sets the DHCP mode for the onboard PROFINET interface on the Control Unit. The active DHCP mode is displayed in r8934.

descriere_scurta: PN interface configuration
descriere: Setting to activate the interface configuration for the onboard PROFINET interface on the Control Unit.

descriere_scurta: PN remote controller number
descriere: Sets the number of remote controllers expected for PROFINET onboard. The "Shared Device" functionality is activated with a value = 2. The drive is being accessed by two PROFINET controllers simultaneously: - automation controller (SIMOTION or SIMATIC A-CPU). - safety controller (SIMATIC F-CPU).

descriere_scurta: CBE2x DHCP Mode
descriere: Sets the DHCP mode for the Communication Board Ethernet 20/25 (CBE20/CBE25).

descriere_scurta: CBE2x interface configuration
descriere: Sets the activation of the interface configuration for the Communication Board Ethernet 20/25 (CBE20/CBE25).

descriere_scurta: PROFIsafe wait for clock synchronization
descriere: Setting for the behavior of a PROFIsafe communication connection depending on another isochronous communication connection.

descriere_scurta: Web server configuration
descriere: Setting to activate and configure the "Web server" function in the drive. It is possible to access the web server via the integrated Ethernet and PROFINET interfaces of the drive. The addressing is realized via the set IP address.

descriere_scurta: Flashing component number
descriere: Sets the component number for a component to get its status LED to flash.

descriere_scurta: Flash function
descriere: Sets the function for the component selected in p9210. After initiating a function, the parameter is automatically reset again.

descriere_scurta: Statistic components Id
descriere: Selects the component Id whose statistics are to be displayed in p9222.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion monitoring clock cycle (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the monitoring clock cycle for safe motion monitoring.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion enable safety functions (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the enable signals for the safe motion monitoring.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion axis type (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the axis type (linear axis or rotary axis/spindle).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SP modulo value (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the modulo value in degrees for rotary axes of the "Safe position" function. This modulo value is taken into account when safely referencing as well as when transferring the safe position via PROFIsafe when the absolute position is enabled. The value should be set, so that it is precisely at 2^n revolutions, so that when the range that can be represented (+/- 2048) overflows, this does not cause the position actual value to jump. The modulo function is deactivated for a value = 0.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion function specification (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the function specification for the safe motion monitoring.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion function configuration MM
descriere: Sets the function configuration for the safe motion monitoring functions.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion behavior during pulse suppression (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the behavior of safety functions and their feedback during pulse suppression in encoderless operation.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion actual value sensing clock cycle (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the clock cycle time of the actual value sensing for safe motion monitoring. Setting criteria if the motion monitoring functions are executed with an encoder. - A slower clock cycle time reduces the maximum permissible velocity - however, it ensures a lower load of the Control Unit for safe actual value sensing. - The maximum permissible velocity which, when exceeded, can mean that errors occur during safe actual value sensing, is displayed in r9730. - The isochronous PROFIBUS clock cycle is used as a clock cycle time for actual value sensing with a setting of 0 ms; the setting is 1 ms if isochronous operation is not being used.

descriere_scurta: Select SI Motion safety functions without selection (MM)
descriere: Sets the safety functions without selection. The safety functions without selection are enabled with p9601.5/p9801.5. Using this parameter, the individual motion monitoring functions can then be selected (e.g. SLS, SDI positive, SDI negative), which should then be permanently selected.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion non safety-relevant measuring steps POS1 (MM)
descriere: Sets the non safety-relevant measuring steps of position value POS1. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on processor 2, must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion absolute encoder linear measuring steps (MM)
descriere: Sets the resolution of the absolute position for a linear absolute encoder. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Motor Module/Hydraulic Module must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion coarse position value configuration (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the encoder configuration for the redundant coarse position value. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Motor Module/Hydraulic Module must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion encoder configuration, safety functions (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the configuration for the encoder and position actual value. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Hydraulic Module must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion linear scale grid division (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the grid division for a linear encoder. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Motor Module/Hydraulic Module must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion encoder pulses per revolution (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the number of encoder pulses per revolution for rotary encoders. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Motor Module/Hydraulic Module must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion fine resolution G1_XIST1 (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the fine resolution for G1_XIST1 in bits. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Motor Module/Hydraulic Module must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion spindle pitch (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the gear ratio between the encoder and load in mm/revolution for a linear axis with rotary encoder. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Motor Module/Hydraulic Module must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion red. coarse position value valid bits (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the number of valid bits of the redundant coarse position value. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Motor Module/Hydraulic Module must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion redundant coarse pos. value fine resolution bits (MM)
descriere: Sets the number of valid bits for the fine resolution of the redundant coarse position value. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Motor Module/Hydraulic Module must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion redundant coarse pos. value relevant bits (MM)
descriere: Sets the number of relevant bits for the redundant coarse position value. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Motor Module/Hydraulic Module must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion encoder assignment (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the number of the encoder, which is used on the Motor Module for safe motion monitoring functions.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion Gx_XIST1 coarse pos safe most significant bit (MM)
descriere: Sets the bit number for the safe most significant bit (MSB) of the Gx_XIST1 coarse position. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Motor Module/Hydraulic Module must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion standstill tolerance (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the tolerance for the function "Safe Operating Stop" (SOS).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion encoder comparison algorithm (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the comparison algorithm for the encoder position monitoring functions. The encoder that is used for the safe motion monitoring functions on the Motor Module/Hydraulic Module must be parameterized in this parameter.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion act val comparison tol (crosswise) (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the tolerance for the crosswise data comparison of the actual position between the two monitoring channels.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion gearbox switching position tolerance (MM)
descriere: Sets the factor to increase the tolerance for the crosswise data comparison of the actual position between the two monitoring channels while the gearbox stage is being switched over. This factor is effective when actual value synchronization is activated and when deactivated. Depending on the following tolerance, the following is obtained: - actual value synchronization activated: p9549 * p9543 - actual value synchronization deactivated: p9542 * p9543

descriere_scurta: SI Motion actual value comparison tolerance (referencing) (MM)
descriere: Sets the tolerance for checking the actual values. For an incremental encoder, the actual values are checked after referencing; for an absolute encoder, when switching on.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SSM filter time (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the filter time for the SSM feedback signal to detect standstill.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SSM velocity limit (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the velocity limit for the SSM feedback signal to detect standstill (n < nx). When this limit value is undershot, the signal "SSM feedback signal active" is set. For p9368 = p9568 = 0 the value in p9346/p9546 is also applicable for the function "SAM".

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SSM velocity hysteresis (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the velocity hysteresis for the SSM feedback signal to detect standstill (n < nx).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SAM actual velocity tolerance (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the velocity tolerance for the "SAM" function.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion slip velocity tolerance (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the velocity tolerance that is used for a 2-encoder system in crosswise comparison between the two monitoring channels.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SLS(SG) changeover/SOS (SBH) delay time (MM)
descriere: Sets the delay time for the SLS changeover and for the activation of SOS for the functions "Safely-Limited Speed" (SLS) and "Safe operating stop" (SOS). When transitioning from a higher to a lower safely-limited speed level, and when activating safe operating stop (SOS), within this delay time, the "old" speed level remains active. This delay is also applicable when activating SLS from the state "SOS and SLS inactive" and activating SOS from the state "SOS inactive".

descriere_scurta: SI Motion transition time STOP C to SOS (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the transition time from STOP C to "Safe Operating Stop" (SOS).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion transition time STOP D to SOS (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the transition time from STOP D to "Safe Operating Stop" (SOS).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion transition time STOP E to SOS (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the transition time from STOP E to "Safe Operating Stop" (SOS).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion transition time STOP F to STOP B (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the transition time from STOP F to STOP B.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion STOP A delay time (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the delay time for STOP A after STOP B / SS1.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion STO test time (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the time after which STO must be active when initiating the test stop.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion acceptance test mode time limit (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the maximum time for the acceptance test mode. If the acceptance test mode takes longer than the selected time limit, then the mode is automatically terminated.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion STO shutdown velocity (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the shutdown velocity for activating STO. Below this velocity "standstill" is assumed and for STOP B / SS1, STO is selected.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SDI tolerance (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the tolerance for the function "Safe motion direction" (SDI). This motion in the monitored direction is still permissible before safety message C30716 is initiated.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SDI delay time (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the delay time for the function "Safe motion direction" (SDI). After selecting the SDI function, then for a maximum of this time, motion in the monitored direction is permissible. This time can therefore be used for braking any motion.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SDI stop response (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the stop response for the function "Safe motion direction" (SDI). This setting applies to both directions of motion.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SAM velocity limit (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the velocity tolerance limit for the "SAM" function. SAM is de-activated once the set velocity limit has been undershot.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion acceptance test mode (Motor Module)
descriere: Setting to select and de-select the acceptance test mode.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion safe position scaling (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the scaling factor to transfer the safe position via PROFIsafe in the 16-bit notation.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion SLP delay time (Motor Module)
descriere: Setting the delay time: -between selecting and activating the "Safety-limited Position" (SLP) function -when changing between the two active SLP ranges, if the new range is not completely contained in the old range.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion STO delay bus failure (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the delay time after which STO is executed when the bus fails.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion brake ramp reference value (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the reference value to define the brake ramp. The rate of rise of the brake ramp depends upon p9381 (reference value) and p9383 (monitoring time).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion brake ramp delay time (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the delay time for monitoring the brake ramp. Monitoring of the brake ramp starts once the delay time has elapsed.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion brake ramp monitoring time (Motor Module)
descriere: Sets the monitoring time to define the brake ramp. The rate of rise of the brake ramp depends upon p9381 (reference value) and p9383 (monitoring time).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion actual value sensing sensorless fault tolerance (MM)
descriere: Sets the tolerance of the plausibility monitoring of the current and voltage angle. A higher value results in a higher degree of ruggedness when reversing at low speeds, as well as in the field weakening range for load steps. An increase is advantageous, if the current or voltage at the motor become small.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion actual value sensing sensorless filter time (MM)
descriere: Sets the filter time for smoothing the actual value with sensorless actual value sensing.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion actual value sensing sensorless minimum current (MM)
descriere: Sets the minimum current for encoderless actual value sensing referred to 1 A (i.e. 1 % = 10 mA). - The value must be increased if C30711 has occurred with message value 1042. - The value must be decreased if C30711 has occurred with message value 1041. For synchronous motors, the following condition must be fulfilled: |p0305 x p9783| >= p9388 x 1.2

descriere_scurta: SI Motion actual value sensing sensorless accel. limit (MM)
descriere: Sets the acceleration limit to filter velocity fluctuations. If this percentage value is increased, when accelerating, velocity peaks that do not reflect the real velocity characteristic can occur. If this value is decreased, and this dampens the velocity peaks when accelerating. - The value must be increased if C30711 with message value 1043 has occurred. - The value must be lowered if acceleration procedures have led to an excessive Safety actual velocity.

descriere_scurta: BICO interconnections search signal source
descriere: Sets the signal source (BO/CO parameter, BICO coded) to search in the signal sinks. The question is answered: How often is a connection made to a signal source in the drive object and from which index are these interconnections saved (r9482 and r9483)?

descriere_scurta: BICO behavior when activating drive objects
descriere: Sets the behavior when activating BICO interconnections to drive objects that are either not capable of operation or have been deactivated.

descriere_scurta: BICO interconnections to de-activated drive objects number
descriere: Displays the number of saved BICO interconnections to drive objects that are either not capable of operation or have been deactivated. BO/CO parameters are on the drive object that is either not capable of operation or has been deactivated (signal source).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion monitoring clock cycle (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the monitoring clock cycle for safe motion monitoring.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion enable safety functions (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the enable signals for the safe motion monitoring.

descriere_scurta: SI Motion axis type (Control Unit)
descriere: Sets the axis type (linear axis or rotary axis/spindle).
